_note: Economic claims carrying a number or a date, June-October 2025, read from the full corpus. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: The digital platform and the beast system are being brought in at speed on the back of the five trillion dollar budget bill.
mentions.quote: the digital platform is being ushered in at a freight train rate
mentions.falsify_match: A US central bank digital currency reaches implementation.
mentions.falsify_miss: No CBDC issuance in the period he implies.

mentions.claim_text: America is past the point of recovery on debt at roughly forty trillion, and the problem is worldwide rather than American.
mentions.quote: We're already at like almost 40 trillion dollars in debt

mentions.claim_text: A major stimulus of five trillion dollars passes and floods the economy, making everything look amazing, which he calls an adrenaline shot into a dead economy that seals the dollar's fate.
mentions.quote: It's going to make everything look like everything is amazing
mentions.falsify_match: A large stimulus passes, output and markets rise, then the currency deteriorates.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such stimulus, or no subsequent currency damage.

mentions.claim_text: The favourable window matches the legislation, because several of the bills only run until 2028.
mentions.quote: Some of these bills only go until 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Conditions deteriorate as the 2028 provisions lapse.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the digital dollar again, fifty cents on the dollar, queues of people, and things crumbling because of it.
mentions.quote: I see the digital dollar. I see the 50 cents on the dollar
mentions.falsify_match: A digital dollar arrives with roughly half the purchasing power.
mentions.falsify_miss: No digital dollar, or no devaluation of that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Bitcoin at all-time highs around $120,000 and describes the crypto situation as sitting on a powder keg.
mentions.quote: Bitcoin going up to all-time highs of $120,000

mentions.claim_text: A deal is described in which a central bank digital currency is included with no back door left to avoid it.
mentions.quote: included was going to be the central bank digital currency
mentions.falsify_match: A US CBDC is legislated or implemented.

mentions.claim_text: In a January vision the housing market was a wave at breaking point, but a shallow one, with hundred dollar bills and gold in the water.
mentions.quote: I saw the housing market going but I saw a wave
mentions.falsify_match: A housing market correction that is real but not deep.
mentions.falsify_miss: Housing continues rising, or collapses severely.

mentions.claim_text: He cites worldwide debt of 352 trillion dollars as the thing gearing up the beast system and a one world order.
mentions.falsify_match: Global debt drives a coordinated monetary restructuring.

mentions.claim_text: Something is coming with interest rates, and he sees a change in the economy across May, June and July running into the 2026 elections, with the Senate, House and governors trying to pump the economy.
mentions.quote: there was something coming with the interest rates
mentions.time_phrase: May, June, July, into the 2026 elections
mentions.falsify_match: Rate moves and a visible pre-election economic push in mid 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Rates and policy are unremarkable through the 2026 midterms.

mentions.claim_text: He says the increase in silver he was shown has arrived and silver is at an all-time high, referring back to the number he gave earlier.
mentions.quote: The increase of silver is at an all-time high
mentions.falsify_match: Silver records confirm all-time highs around October 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: Silver was not at an all-time high then.

mentions.claim_text: A great shaking is about to take place in the earth, not only in America, which he has been warning about repeatedly.
mentions.quote: a major shaking is about to take place in this earth
mentions.falsify_miss: No global dislocation in the period implied.
